topic.label: Financial and Economic Data
topic.desc: Financial and Economic Data: Financial Models, Fundamentals and Filings Data, Data Quality and Lineage, Economic Data, Financial Statements and Market and Reference Data.

concepts.label: Financial Statements
concepts.desc: Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement and how they link.

concepts.label: Economic Data
concepts.desc: GDP, inflation, employment, interest rates and other macro series and their release calendars.

concepts.label: Fundamentals and Filings Data
concepts.desc: Standardized financial statements, XBRL, estimates and transcripts.

concepts.label: Market and Reference Data
concepts.desc: Prices, quotes, trades, corporate actions, identifiers (ticker, CUSIP, ISIN, FIGI) and data vendors.

concepts.label: Financial Models
concepts.desc: Three-statement models, DCF, LBO, merger and budget models, in spreadsheets and code, with assumptions and checks.

concepts.label: Data Quality and Lineage
concepts.desc: Checking financial data: gaps, outliers, restatements, survivorship and lineage.

skills.label: Financial Statement Reader
skills.desc: Reads a company's financial statements and summarizes profitability, liquidity and leverage.

skills.label: Three-Statement Linker
skills.desc: Shows how a transaction flows through the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement.

skills.label: Economic Series Finder
skills.desc: Finds the official series for an economic indicator and its release schedule.

skills.label: XBRL Extractor
skills.desc: Extracts financial statement values from XBRL filings with their tags and periods.

skills.label: Identifier Mapper
skills.desc: Maps a security between ticker, CUSIP, ISIN and FIGI and flags mismatches.

skills.label: Market Data Source Selector
skills.desc: Chooses a market data source by coverage, latency, history and cost.

skills.label: Model Auditor
skills.desc: Audits a financial model for broken links, hard-coded numbers and balance sheet that does not balance.

skills.label: Three-Statement Model Builder
skills.desc: Builds a linked three-statement model with assumptions separated from formulas.

skills.label: Price Data Validator
skills.desc: Checks a price series for gaps, outliers, splits and stale values.

mcp.name: Financial Datasets MCP
mcp.desc: Financial Datasets MCP server: company income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, stock prices and market news.

mcp.name: FRED MCP
mcp.desc: FRED MCP server: Federal Reserve Economic Data series, interest rates, inflation, GDP, employment and economic indicators.

mcp.name: Polygon MCP
mcp.desc: Polygon.io MCP server: market data for stocks, options, indices, forex and crypto, aggregates, trades, quotes, reference data and financials.

mcp.name: QuickBooks Online MCP
mcp.desc: Intuit QuickBooks Online MCP server: accounting records, accounts, customers, vendors, invoices, bills and journal entries.

mcp.name: SEC EDGAR MCP
mcp.desc: SEC EDGAR MCP server: company filings, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, XBRL financial data and insider trading forms from EDGAR.
